[Skip to main content](https://supportgowhere.life.gov.sg/schemes/BSG/baby-support-grant#main-content) # Baby Support Grant - SupportGoWhere Baby Support Grant Share link Help parents ease financial concerns about raising a child during extraordinary times. SCHEME HIGHLIGHTS - One-off cash payout of $3,000 for eligible Singaporean children - Extended to eligible Singaporean children born from 1 Oct 2022 to 13 Feb 2023 - No application needed if you have applied for Baby Bonus Scheme previously Expand all sections About this support | The SG Child Support Package announced at the 2026 National Day Rally will replace the current Baby Bonus Scheme and Large Families Scheme. Those currently on the Baby Bonus Scheme will be automatically transitioned to the Package. In the meantime, existing payouts will continue as usual.
Learn more about the [SG Child Support Package](https://go.gov.sg/sgchildsupportpackage). | Eligible Singaporean children born from 1 Oct 2022 to 13 Feb 2023 qualify for the one-off cash payout of $3,000. The Grant will be disbursed from the second half of 2023. Who is this for? - Child is a Singapore Citizen - Children born from 1 Oct 2022 to 13 Feb 2023 - Parents are lawfully married - Children who are already receiving the Baby Bonus Cash Gift are also eligible for the Baby Support Grant. How to apply? - No application needed if you have applied for Baby Bonus Scheme previously. - From 1 July 2024, improvements to Baby Bonus services were made easier for parents for Baby Bonus application and accounts related services: - All parents can apply for Baby Bonus Scheme at LifeSG: - [Bundled service](https://www.life.gov.sg/services/birth-registration) together with child’s birth registration - [Direct application](https://www.life.gov.sg/services/baby-bonus) for child who has already registered for birth Where can I find help? [Baby Bonus Scheme \| LifeSG](https://www.life.gov.sg/family-parenting/benefits-support/baby-bonus-scheme) * * * MSF Consolidated hotline: [1800 111 2222](tel:18002537707) Operating hours: Mon to Fri 8.30am to 6pm \| Saturday: 8.30am to 1pm (Closed on Public Holidays) _Airtime charges apply for mobile calls to 1800 service lines_ Airtime charges apply for mobile calls to 1800 service lines. Calls are free of charge only if made from regular land lines in Singapore. Scheme last updated 01 Sep 2026 Try our AI search
